WITH txn_visitors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
    AND totals.transactions IS NOT NULL
),
all_sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    f.fullVisitorId,
    f.date,
    f.totals.transactions AS txn_count,
    f.device.deviceCategory
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` f
  JOIN txn_visitors t ON f.fullVisitorId = t.fullVisitorId
  WHERE f._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) AS first_visit_date,
    MIN(CASE WHEN txn_count IS NOT NULL THEN date END) AS first_txn_date,
    ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(date, deviceCategory, txn_count) ORDER BY date ASC) AS date_device_txn
  FROM all_sessions
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
)
SELECT 
  fullVisitorId,
  first_visit_date,
  first_txn_date,
  DATE_DIFF(
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_txn_date),
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_visit_date),
    DAY
  ) AS days_elapsed,
  (SELECT deviceCategory FROM UNNEST(date_device_txn) WHERE date = first_txn_date AND txn_count IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1) AS first_txn_device
FROM agg
ORDER BY days_elapsed

SELECT 
  date,
  SUM(p.productRevenue) AS daily_rev
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_20170101`,
UNNEST(hits) AS h,
UNNEST(h.product) AS p
WHERE p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
  AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
GROUP BY date

WITH session_product AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    MAX(h.product[SAFE_OFFSET(0)].productRevenue) AS max_product_revenue
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170401' AND '20170731'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId, date
)
SELECT 
  DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', s.date), MONTH) AS month,
  CASE 
    WHEN s.totals.transactions >= 1 AND sp.max_product_revenue IS NOT NULL THEN 'purchase'
    WHEN s.totals.transactions IS NULL AND sp.max_product_revenue IS NULL THEN 'non-purchase'
  END AS session_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.fullVisitorId) AS unique_visitors,
  AVG(s.totals.pageviews) AS avg_pageviews
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` s
LEFT JOIN session_product sp 
  ON s.fullVisitorId = sp.fullVisitorId AND s.date = sp.date
WHERE s._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170401' AND '20170731'
  AND (
    (s.totals.transactions >= 1 AND sp.max_product_revenue IS NOT NULL) OR
    (s.totals.transactions IS NULL AND sp.max_product_revenue IS NULL)
  )
GROUP BY month, session_type
ORDER BY month, session_type

WITH all_page_hits AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    visitId,
    visitNumber,
    h.hitNumber,
    h.time,
    h.type,
    h.page.pagePath
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) as h
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170131'
    AND LOWER(trafficSource.campaign) LIKE '%data share%'
    AND h.page.pagePath IS NOT NULL
    AND h.type = 'PAGE'
),
hits_with_next AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    visitId,
    visitNumber,
    hitNumber,
    time,
    type,
    pagePath,
    LEAD(time) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY hitNumber) as next_time,
    LEAD(pagePath) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY hitNumber) as next_pagePath
  FROM all_page_hits
),
home_with_next AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    visitId,
    visitNumber,
    hitNumber,
    time as homeTime,
    pagePath as homePagePath,
    next_time,
    next_pagePath
  FROM hits_with_next
  WHERE LOWER(pagePath) LIKE '/home%'
    AND next_time IS NOT NULL
),
most_common_next AS (
  SELECT next_pagePath
  FROM home_with_next
  GROUP BY next_pagePath
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  mc.next_pagePath as most_common_next_page,
  (SELECT MAX(hwn.next_time - hwn.homeTime) FROM home_with_next hwn) as max_time_on_home_seconds
FROM home_with_next hwn
JOIN most_common_next mc ON hwn.next_pagePath = mc.next_pagePath
GROUP BY mc.next_pagePath
LIMIT 1

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as month,
    SUM(totals.totalTransactionRevenue) as monthly_rev
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20171231'
    AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
    AND totals.totalTransactionRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT 
  '(direct)' as traffic_source,
  ROUND((MAX(monthly_rev) - MIN(monthly_rev)) / 1000000, 2) as diff_in_millions
FROM monthly_revenue

WITH qualifying_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(hits) h
      WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(h.product) p
        WHERE p.v2ProductName = 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley'
          AND h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6'
      )
    )
)
SELECT 
  p.v2ProductName AS productName,
  SUM(p.productQuantity) AS totalQuantity
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` AS ga,
qualifying_customers qc,
UNNEST(ga.hits) h,
UNNEST(h.product) p
WHERE ga.fullVisitorId = qc.fullVisitorId
  AND p.v2ProductName != 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley'
  AND p.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL
  AND p.productQuantity IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.v2ProductName
ORDER BY totalQuantity DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH users_7day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210101' AND '20210107'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'engagement_time_msec' AND value.int_value > 0)
),
users_2day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210106' AND '20210107'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'engagement_time_msec' AND value.int_value > 0)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as count_distinct_pseudo_users
FROM users_7day u7
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users_2day u2 WHERE u2.user_pseudo_id = u7.user_pseudo_id)

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    new_confirmed,
    LAG(new_confirmed) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS prev_new_confirmed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
  WHERE country_code = 'US' AND aggregation_level = 0 
    AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date) IN (3, 4)
)
SELECT FORMAT('%02d-%02d', EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date), EXTRACT(DAY FROM date)) AS mm_dd
FROM daily
WHERE prev_new_confirmed IS NOT NULL AND prev_new_confirmed > 0
ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(new_confirmed - prev_new_confirmed, prev_new_confirmed) DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT trip_seconds, fare
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips`
  WHERE trip_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 3600
),
with_quantile AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_seconds,
    fare,
    NTILE(6) OVER (ORDER BY trip_seconds) AS quantile_group
  FROM filtered
)
SELECT 
  quantile_group,
  ROUND(MIN(trip_seconds / 60.0)) AS min_duration_minutes,
  ROUND(MAX(trip_seconds / 60.0)) AS max_duration_minutes,
  COUNT(*) AS total_trips,
  AVG(fare) AS avg_fare
FROM with_quantile
GROUP BY quantile_group
ORDER BY quantile_group

SELECT 
  ct.census_tract_geoid,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(i.transaction_amt), COUNT(*)), 2) as avg_donation,
  c.median_income
FROM `bigquery-public-data.fec.indiv20` i
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.hud_zipcode_crosswalk.zipcode_to_census_tracts` ct 
  ON SUBSTR(i.zip_code, 1, 5) = ct.zip_code
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr` c
  ON ct.census_tract_geoid = c.geo_id
WHERE i.state = 'NY'
  AND ct.census_tract_geoid LIKE '36047%'
  AND i.transaction_amt IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ct.census_tract_geoid, c.median_income
ORDER BY ct.census_tract_geoid

WITH condition_acres AS (
  SELECT 
    p.evaluation_group,
    p.evaluation_group_description,
    p.evaluation_type,
    c.condition_status_code,
    p.evaluation_description,
    c.state_code,
    SUM(c.macroplot_proportion_unadjusted * p.expansion_factor * COALESCE(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot, 1)) AS macroplot_acres,
    SUM(c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted * p.expansion_factor * COALESCE(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot, 1)) AS subplot_acres
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c 
    ON p.plot_sequence_number = c.plot_sequence_number
    AND p.inventory_year = c.inventory_year
    AND p.state_code = c.state_code
  WHERE p.inventory_year = 2012
  GROUP BY p.evaluation_group, p.evaluation_group_description, p.evaluation_type, c.condition_status_code, p.evaluation_description, c.state_code
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    evaluation_group,
    evaluation_group_description,
    evaluation_type,
    condition_status_code,
    evaluation_description,
    state_code,
    macroplot_acres,
    subplot_acres,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY evaluation_group ORDER BY subplot_acres DESC) AS rn
  FROM condition_acres
)
SELECT 
  evaluation_group,
  evaluation_group_description,
  evaluation_type,
  condition_status_code,
  evaluation_description,
  state_code,
  macroplot_acres,
  subplot_acres
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY subplot_acres DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH daily_data AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) as date,
        ROUND((temp - 32) * 5.0/9.0, 1) as temp_c,
        ROUND(prcp * 2.54, 1) as prcp_cm,
        ROUND(CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) * 0.514444, 1) as wdsp_ms
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019` 
    WHERE stn = '725290' AND year = '2019' AND mo IN ('01', '02', '03')
),
with_moving_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        date,
        temp_c,
        prcp_cm,
        wdsp_ms,
        ROUND(AVG(temp_c) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) as temp_ma8,
        ROUND(AVG(prcp_cm) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) as prcp_ma8,
        ROUND(AVG(wdsp_ms) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) as wdsp_ma8
    FROM daily_data
)
SELECT 
    date,
    temp_c,
    prcp_cm,
    wdsp_ms,
    temp_ma8,
    prcp_ma8,
    wdsp_ma8,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as temp_lag1,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as prcp_lag1,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as wdsp_lag1,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as temp_lag2,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as prcp_lag2,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as wdsp_lag2,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as temp_lag3,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as prcp_lag3,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as wdsp_lag3,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as temp_lag4,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as prcp_lag4,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as wdsp_lag4,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as temp_lag5,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as prcp_lag5,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as wdsp_lag5,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as temp_lag6,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as prcp_lag6,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as wdsp_lag6,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as temp_lag7,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as prcp_lag7,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as wdsp_lag7,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as temp_lag8,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as prcp_lag8,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as wdsp_lag8
FROM with_moving_avg
WHERE date >= '2019-01-09'
ORDER BY date

SELECT id, name
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_stations`
WHERE ST_DISTANCE(
  ST_GEOGPOINT(-87.6847, 41.8319),
  ST_GEOGPOINT(longitude, latitude)
) <= 50000
ORDER BY ST_DISTANCE(
  ST_GEOGPOINT(-87.6847, 41.8319),
  ST_GEOGPOINT(longitude, latitude)
)

SELECT
  t.bike_number,
  SUM(
    6371000 * ACOS(
      LEAST(
        1,
        SIN(s.latitude * 3.14159265358979 / 180) * SIN(e.latitude * 3.14159265358979 / 180) +
        COS(s.latitude * 3.14159265358979 / 180) * COS(e.latitude * 3.14159265358979 / 180) *
        COS((s.longitude - e.longitude) * 3.14159265358979 / 180)
      )
    )
  ) AS total_distance_meters
FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips` t
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_stations` s
  ON t.start_station_id = s.station_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_stations` e
  ON t.end_station_id = e.station_id
GROUP BY t.bike_number
ORDER BY t.bike_number

-- Final query with station_id and station_name
WITH all_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    start_station_name,
    end_station_id,
    end_station_name,
    starttime,
    stoptime
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
),
-- Get the most common name for each station
station_names AS (
  SELECT start_station_id, start_station_name,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY start_station_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rn
  FROM all_trips
  GROUP BY start_station_id, start_station_name
),
most_common_name AS (
  SELECT start_station_id, start_station_name
  FROM station_names
  WHERE rn = 1
),
-- Total trips ending at each station
total_trips_per_end_station AS (
  SELECT end_station_id, COUNT(*) as total_trips
  FROM all_trips
  GROUP BY end_station_id
),
-- Same station trips (start = end)
same_station_trips AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM all_trips
  WHERE start_station_id = end_station_id
),
-- Add 2-minute window key based on starttime
trips_with_window AS (
  SELECT *,
         CONCAT(CAST(DATE(starttime) AS STRING), '_', 
                CAST(FLOOR((EXTRACT(HOUR FROM starttime) * 3600 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM starttime) * 60 + EXTRACT(SECOND FROM starttime)) / 120.0) AS STRING)) as window_key
  FROM same_station_trips
),
-- Count trips per station per window, keep windows with >= 2 trips
window_counts AS (
  SELECT start_station_id, window_key, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM trips_with_window
  GROUP BY start_station_id, window_key
  HAVING cnt >= 2
),
-- Mark which trips are group rides
group_rides AS (
  SELECT tw.start_station_id
  FROM trips_with_window tw
  JOIN window_counts wc ON tw.start_station_id = wc.start_station_id AND tw.window_key = wc.window_key
),
-- Count group rides per station
group_rides_per_station AS (
  SELECT start_station_id, COUNT(*) as group_ride_count
  FROM group_rides
  GROUP BY start_station_id
)
SELECT 
  mc.start_station_name as station_name,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(gs.group_ride_count, te.total_trips) as proportion
FROM group_rides_per_station gs
JOIN total_trips_per_end_station te ON gs.start_station_id = te.end_station_id
JOIN most_common_name mc ON gs.start_station_id = mc.start_station_id
ORDER BY proportion DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', date) as month,
  '52003' as zip_code,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(volume_sold_liters), 9882) as monthly_per_capita_liters
FROM `bigquery-public-data.iowa_liquor_sales.sales`
WHERE county = 'DUBUQUE'
  AND category_name IN ('STRAIGHT BOURBON WHISKIES', 'SINGLE BARREL BOURBON WHISKIES', 'BOTTLED IN BOND BOURBON')
  AND date >= '2022-01-01' AND date < '2023-01-01'
  AND SAFE_CAST(SAFE_CAST(zip_code AS FLOAT64) AS STRING) = '52003'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

WITH daily_prcp AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    SUM(value) / 10.0 AS total_precip_mm
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_2016`
  WHERE id = 'US1NYKN0025' 
    AND element = 'PRCP' 
    AND (qflag IS NULL OR qflag = '')
  GROUP BY date
),
weather_days AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    CASE WHEN total_precip_mm > 5 THEN 'rainy' ELSE 'non-rainy' END AS weather_condition
  FROM daily_prcp
),
daily_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(starttime) AS trip_date,
    COUNT(*) AS trip_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE DATE(starttime) BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-12-31'
  GROUP BY DATE(starttime)
)
SELECT 
  w.weather_condition,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(COALESCE(d.trip_count, 0)), COUNT(*)), 2) AS avg_daily_trips
FROM weather_days w
LEFT JOIN daily_trips d ON w.date = d.trip_date
GROUP BY w.weather_condition
ORDER BY w.weather_condition

WITH 
trees_1995 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) as spc_latin_upper,
    COUNT(*) as alive_1995
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE status != 'Dead'
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
trees_2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) as spc_latin_upper,
    COUNT(*) as alive_2015
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE status = 'Alive'
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
species_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    ts.fall_color,
    COALESCE(t19.alive_1995, 0) as alive_1995,
    COALESCE(t25.alive_2015, 0) as alive_2015,
    COALESCE(t19.alive_1995, 0) - COALESCE(t25.alive_2015, 0) as diff
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_species` ts
  LEFT JOIN trees_1995 t19 ON UPPER(ts.species_scientific_name) = t19.spc_latin_upper
  LEFT JOIN trees_2015 t25 ON UPPER(ts.species_scientific_name) = t25.spc_latin_upper
)
SELECT 
  fall_color,
  SUM(diff) as total_change
FROM species_counts
GROUP BY fall_color
ORDER BY fall_color

WITH 
census_1995 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS spc_latin_upper,
    COUNT(*) AS total_1995,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('Good', 'Excellent', 'Fair', 'Critical', 'Poor') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alive_1995,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Dead' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead_1995
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
census_2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS spc_latin_upper,
    COUNT(*) AS total_2015,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Alive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alive_2015,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Dead' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead_2015
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
species_common AS (
  SELECT 
    spc_latin_upper,
    spc_common,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY spc_latin_upper ORDER BY cnt DESC) as rn
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      UPPER(spc_latin) AS spc_latin_upper,
      spc_common,
      COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
    WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
    GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin), spc_common
  )
)
SELECT 
  c1.spc_latin_upper,
  sc.spc_common AS common_name,
  c1.total_1995,
  c2.total_2015,
  c1.alive_1995,
  c2.alive_2015,
  c1.dead_1995,
  c2.dead_2015,
  c2.total_2015 - c1.total_1995 AS total_growth,
  c2.alive_2015 - c1.alive_1995 AS alive_growth,
  c2.dead_2015 - c1.dead_1995 AS dead_growth
FROM census_1995 c1
INNER JOIN census_2015 c2 ON c1.spc_latin_upper = c2.spc_latin_upper
INNER JOIN species_common sc ON c1.spc_latin_upper = sc.spc_latin_upper AND sc.rn = 1
ORDER BY total_growth DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH bls_tech AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(percent_white) AS avg_white,
    AVG(percent_black_or_african_american) AS avg_black,
    AVG(percent_asian) AS avg_asian,
    AVG(percent_hispanic_or_latino) AS avg_hispanic
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpsaat18`
  WHERE year = 2021
    AND (
      subsector = 'Internet publishing and broadcasting and web search portals'
      OR subsector = 'Software publishers'
      OR subsector = 'Data processing, hosting, and related services'
      OR industry_group = 'Computer systems design and related services'
    )
),
google_hiring AS (
  SELECT 
    race_asian, race_black, race_hispanic_latinx, race_native_american, race_white

diffs AS (

WITH data_2016 AS (
  SELECT 
    n.County_of_Residence_FIPS,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      SUM(CASE WHEN n.Maternal_Morbidity_YN = 1 THEN n.Births ELSE 0 END),
      SUM(n.Births)
    ) as pct_no_morbidity,
    MIN(SAFE_DIVIDE(c.poverty, c.pop_determined_poverty_status)) as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_maternal_morbidity` n
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2015_5yr` c 
    ON n.County_of_Residence_FIPS = c.geo_id
  WHERE n.Year = '2016-01-01' 
    AND n.Maternal_Morbidity_YN IN (0, 1)
    AND c.pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
  GROUP BY n.County_of_Residence_FIPS
),
data_2017 AS (
  SELECT 
    n.County_of_Residence_FIPS,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      SUM(CASE WHEN n.Maternal_Morbidity_YN = 1 THEN n.Births ELSE 0 END),
      SUM(n.Births)
    ) as pct_no_morbidity,
    MIN(SAFE_DIVIDE(c.poverty, c.pop_determined_poverty_status)) as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_maternal_morbidity` n
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2016_5yr` c 
    ON n.County_of_Residence_FIPS = c.geo_id
  WHERE n.Year = '2017-01-01' 
    AND n.Maternal_Morbidity_YN IN (0, 1)
    AND c.pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
  GROUP BY n.County_of_Residence_FIPS
),
data_2018 AS (
  SELECT 
    n.County_of_Residence_FIPS,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      SUM(CASE WHEN n.Maternal_Morbidity_YN = 1 THEN n.Births ELSE 0 END),
      SUM(n.Births)
    ) as pct_no_morbidity,
    MIN(SAFE_DIVIDE(c.poverty, c.pop_determined_poverty_status)) as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_maternal_morbidity` n
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr` c 
    ON n.County_of_Residence_FIPS = c.geo_id
  WHERE n.Year = '2018-01-01' 
    AND n.Maternal_Morbidity_YN IN (0, 1)
    AND c.pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
  GROUP BY n.County_of_Residence_FIPS
),
corr_2016 AS (
  SELECT 
    2016 as year,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      (COUNT(*) * SUM(poverty_rate * pct_no_morbidity) - SUM(poverty_rate) * SUM(pct_no_morbidity)),
      SQRT((COUNT(*) * SUM(poverty_rate * poverty_rate) - SUM(poverty_rate) * SUM(poverty_rate)) * 
           (COUNT(*) * SUM(pct_no_morbidity * pct_no_morbidity) - SUM(pct_no_morbidity) * SUM(pct_no_morbidity)))
    ) as pearson_r
  FROM data_2016
),
corr_2017 AS (
  SELECT 
    2017 as year,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      (COUNT(*) * SUM(poverty_rate * pct_no_morbidity) - SUM(poverty_rate) * SUM(pct_no_morbidity)),
      SQRT((COUNT(*) * SUM(poverty_rate * poverty_rate) - SUM(poverty_rate) * SUM(poverty_rate)) * 
           (COUNT(*) * SUM(pct_no_morbidity * pct_no_morbidity) - SUM(pct_no_morbidity) * SUM(pct_no_morbidity)))
    ) as pearson_r
  FROM data_2017
),
corr_2018 AS (
  SELECT 
    2018 as year,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      (COUNT(*) * SUM(poverty_rate * pct_no_morbidity) - SUM(poverty_rate) * SUM(pct_no_morbidity)),
      SQRT((COUNT(*) * SUM(poverty_rate * poverty_rate) - SUM(poverty_rate) * SUM(poverty_rate)) * 
           (COUNT(*) * SUM(pct_no_morbidity * pct_no_morbidity) - SUM(pct_no_morbidity) * SUM(pct_no_morbidity)))
    ) as pearson_r
  FROM data_2018
)
SELECT * FROM corr_2016
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM corr_2017
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM corr_2018
ORDER BY year

WITH accident_persons AS (
  SELECT 
    state_number,
    consecutive_number,
    COUNT(DISTINCT person_number) AS distinct_persons,
    SUM(CASE WHEN injury_severity = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fatal_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.person_2016`
  GROUP BY state_number, consecutive_number
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT person_number) > 1
),
first_vehicle AS (
  SELECT 
    state_number,
    consecutive_number,
    body_type,
    travel_speed,
    speed_limit
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      state_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number, body_type, travel_speed, speed_limit,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY state_number, consecutive_number ORDER BY vehicle_number) AS rn
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.vehicle_2016`
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
),
speed_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    state_number,
    consecutive_number,
    AVG(ABS(CAST(travel_speed AS FLOAT64) - CAST(speed_limit AS FLOAT64))) AS avg_speed_diff
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.vehicle_2016`
  WHERE travel_speed NOT IN (997, 998, 999)
    AND travel_speed IS NOT NULL
    AND speed_limit NOT IN (98, 99)
    AND speed_limit IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY state_number, consecutive_number
)
SELECT 
  ap.state_number,
  fv.body_type,
  a.number_of_drunk_drivers,
  a.day_of_week,
  a.hour_of_crash,
  CASE WHEN a.work_zone != 'None' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS work_zone_binary,
  CASE 
    WHEN sd.avg_speed_diff >= 0 AND sd.avg_speed_diff < 20 THEN 0
    WHEN sd.avg_speed_diff >= 20 AND sd.avg_speed_diff < 40 THEN 1
    WHEN sd.avg_speed_diff >= 40 AND sd.avg_speed_diff < 60 THEN 2
    WHEN sd.avg_speed_diff >= 60 AND sd.avg_speed_diff < 80 THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END AS speed_diff_category,
  CASE WHEN ap.fatal_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS label
FROM accident_persons ap
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2016` a 
  ON ap.state_number = a.state_number AND ap.consecutive_number = a.consecutive_number
JOIN first_vehicle fv
  ON ap.state_number = fv.state_number AND ap.consecutive_number = fv.consecutive_number
JOIN speed_diff sd
  ON ap.state_number = sd.state_number AND ap.consecutive_number = sd.consecutive_number
LIMIT 10

WITH latest_eval AS (
  SELECT state_code, MAX(evaluation_group) as latest_eval_group
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population`
  WHERE evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
  GROUP BY state_code
),
filtered_pop AS (
  SELECT p.plot_sequence_number, p.state_code, p.evaluation_group, p.evaluation_group_description,
         p.expansion_factor, p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot, p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
  JOIN latest_eval l ON p.state_code = l.state_code AND p.evaluation_group = l.latest_eval_group
  WHERE p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
),
condition_acres AS (
  SELECT 
    fp.state_code,
    fp.evaluation_group,
    fp.evaluation_group_description,
    c.condition_status_code,
    c.reserved_status_code,
    c.site_productivity_class_code,
    c.proportion_basis,
    CASE 
      WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'MACR' AND fp.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot > 0 THEN fp.expansion_factor * c.condition_proportion_unadjusted * fp.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot
      WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP' AND fp.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot > 0 THEN fp.expansion_factor * c.condition_proportion_unadjusted * fp.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
      ELSE 0
    END as acres
  FROM filtered_pop fp
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c ON fp.plot_sequence_number = c.plot_sequence_number
),
timberland_acres AS (
  SELECT state_code, evaluation_group, evaluation_group_description,
         SUM(acres) as total_acres
  FROM condition_acres
  WHERE condition_status_code = 1 
    AND reserved_status_code = 0 
    AND site_productivity_class_code BETWEEN 1 AND 6
  GROUP BY state_code, evaluation_group, evaluation_group_description
),
forestland_acres AS (
  SELECT state_code, evaluation_group, evaluation_group_description,
         SUM(acres) as total_acres
  FROM condition_acres
  WHERE condition_status_code = 1
  GROUP BY state_code, evaluation_group, evaluation_group_description
),
timberland_ranked AS (
  SELECT state_code, evaluation_group, evaluation_group_description, total_acres,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_acres DESC) as rn
  FROM timberland_acres
),
forestland_ranked AS (
  SELECT state_code, evaluation_group, evaluation_group_description, total_acres,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_acres DESC) as rn
  FROM forestland_acres
),
state_names AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT state_code, state_code_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition`
)
SELECT 
  'timberland' as category,
  CAST(tr.state_code AS STRING) as state_code,
  CAST(tr.evaluation_group AS STRING) as evaluation_group,
  sn.state_code_name as state_name,
  tr.total_acres as total_acres
FROM timberland_ranked tr
JOIN state_names sn ON tr.state_code = sn.state_code
WHERE tr.rn = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'forestland' as category,
  CAST(fr.state_code AS STRING) as state_code,
  CAST(fr.evaluation_group AS STRING) as evaluation_group,
  sn.state_code_name as state_name,
  fr.total_acres as total_acres
FROM forestland_ranked fr
JOIN state_names sn ON fr.state_code = sn.state_code
WHERE fr.rn = 1

WITH distracted_accidents AS (
  SELECT 
    a.state_number,
    a.state_name,
    2015 as year_of_crash,

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2015` a
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.distract_2015` d 
    ON a.state_number = d.state_number AND a.consecutive_number = d.consecutive_number
  WHERE d.driver_distracted_by_name NOT IN ('Not Distracted', 'Unknown if Distracted', 'Not Reported')
  GROUP BY a.state_number, a.state_name
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    a.state_number,
    a.state_name,
    2016 as year_of_crash,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.consecutive_number) as distracted_accidents
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2016` a
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.distract_2016` d 
    ON a.state_number = d.state_number AND a.consecutive_number = d.consecutive_number
  WHERE d.driver_distracted_by_name NOT IN ('Not Distracted', 'Unknown if Distracted', 'Not Reported')
  GROUP BY a.state_number, a.state_name
),
state_pop AS (
  SELECT 
    za.state_fips,
    za.state_name,

  WHERE p.gender = '' OR p.gender IS NULL

state_rates AS (

    da.year_of_crash,

SELECT

  distracted_accidents,
  total_population,

WITH question_answers AS (
  SELECT 
    q.id as question_id,
    q.creation_date as question_date,
    EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM q.creation_date) as dow,
    (SELECT MIN(a.creation_date) 
     FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a 
     WHERE a.parent_id = q.id) as earliest_answer_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
),
day_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    dow,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      SUM(CASE WHEN earliest_answer_date IS NOT NULL 
               AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(earliest_answer_date, question_date, SECOND) >= 0 
               AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(earliest_answer_date, question_date, SECOND) <= 3600 
               THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      COUNT(*)
    ) as pct_answered_within_hour
  FROM question_answers
  GROUP BY dow
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    dow,
    pct_answered_within_hour,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pct_answered_within_hour DESC) as rank
  FROM day_stats
)
SELECT 
  dow,
  CASE dow
    WHEN 1 THEN 'Sunday'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'Monday'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'Tuesday'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'Wednesday'
    WHEN 5 THEN 'Thursday'
    WHEN 6 THEN 'Friday'
    WHEN 7 THEN 'Saturday'
  END as day_name,
  ROUND(pct_answered_within_hour * 100, 2) as percentage
FROM ranked
WHERE rank = 3

WITH filtered_samples AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT RefNo, CaseNo
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.Cytogen`
  WHERE Morph = '3111' AND Topo = '0401'
),
total_samples AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM filtered_samples
),
band_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    c.Chr,
    c.ChrOrd,
    c.Start,
    c.`End`,
    c.Type,
    cb.cytoband_name,
    cb.hg38_start,
    cb.hg38_stop
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` c
  JOIN filtered_samples fs ON c.RefNo = fs.RefNo AND c.CaseNo = fs.CaseNo
  JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.CytoBands_hg38` cb
    ON c.Chr = cb.chromosome 
    AND c.Start >= cb.hg38_start 
    AND c.Start < cb.hg38_stop
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT 
    Chr,
    ChrOrd,
    cytoband_name,
    hg38_start,
    hg38_stop,
    Type,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM band_changes
  GROUP BY Chr, ChrOrd, cytoband_name, hg38_start, hg38_stop, Type
)
SELECT 
  a.Chr,
  a.ChrOrd,
  a.cytoband_name,
  a.hg38_start,
  a.hg38_stop,
  a.Type,
  a.cnt,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(a.cnt * 100, t.total), 2) as frequency
FROM aggregated a
CROSS JOIN total_samples t
ORDER BY a.ChrOrd, a.hg38_start, a.hg38_stop, a.Type

WITH region1 AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `End`,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) as rn
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr13' AND Type = 'Loss'
    AND Start < 48481890 AND `End` > 48303751
),
region2 AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `End`,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) as rn
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr17' AND Type = 'Loss'
    AND Start < 7687490 AND `End` > 7668421
),
region3 AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `End`,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) as rn
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr11' AND Type = 'Gain'
    AND Start < 108369102 AND `End` > 108223067
),
matching_clones AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT r1.RefNo, r1.CaseNo, r1.InvNo, r1.Clone
  FROM region1 r1
  JOIN region2 r2 ON r1.RefNo = r2.RefNo AND r1.CaseNo = r2.CaseNo AND r1.InvNo = r2.InvNo AND r1.Clone = r2.Clone
  JOIN region3 r3 ON r1.RefNo = r3.RefNo AND r1.CaseNo = r3.CaseNo AND r1.InvNo = r3.InvNo AND r1.Clone = r3.Clone
)
SELECT mc.RefNo, mc.CaseNo, mc.InvNo, mc.Clone,
       c13.ChrOrd AS ChrOrd_13, c13.Start AS Start_13, c13.`End` AS End_13,
       c17.ChrOrd AS ChrOrd_17, c17.Start AS Start_17, c17.`End` AS End_17,
       c11.ChrOrd AS ChrOrd_11, c11.Start AS Start_11, c11.`End` AS End_11,
       kc.CloneShort
FROM matching_clones mc
JOIN region1 c13 ON mc.RefNo = c13.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c13.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c13.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c13.Clone AND c13.rn = 1
JOIN region2 c17 ON mc.RefNo = c17.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c17.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c17.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c17.Clone AND c17.rn = 1
JOIN region3 c11 ON mc.RefNo = c11.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c11.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c11.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c11.Clone AND c11.rn = 1
JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.KaryClone` kc ON mc.RefNo = kc.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = kc.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = kc.InvNo AND mc.Clone = kc.CloneNo
ORDER BY mc.RefNo, mc.CaseNo, mc.InvNo, mc.Clone

WITH monthly_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_id,
    duration_sec,
    start_date,
    FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y%m', start_date) as year_month,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y%m', start_date) ORDER BY start_date ASC) as rn_first,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y%m', start_date) ORDER BY start_date DESC) as rn_last,
    MAX(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y%m', start_date)) as max_dur,
    MIN(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y%m', start_date)) as min_dur
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips`
)
SELECT 
  year_month,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_first = 1 THEN duration_sec END), 60) as first_duration_min,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_last = 1 THEN duration_sec END), 60) as last_duration_min,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(MAX(max_dur), 60) as highest_duration_min,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(MAX(min_dur), 60) as lowest_duration_min
FROM monthly_trips
GROUP BY year_month
ORDER BY year_month

                                  awayFielder6, awayFielder7, awayFielder8, awayFielder9,

                                  homeFielder6, homeFielder7, homeFielder8, homeFielder9, 
                                  homeFielder10, homeFielder11, homeFielder12) 
              THEN homeTeamId
              ELSE NULL END as pitcherTeamId,
         CASE WHEN pitcherId IN (awayFielder1, awayFielder2, awayFielder3, awayFielder4, awayFielder5, 
                                  awayFielder6, awayFielder7, awayFielder8, awayFielder9, 
                                  awayFielder10, awayFielder11, awayFielder12)

              WHEN pitcherId IN (homeFielder1, homeFielder2, homeFielder3, homeFielder4, homeFielder5, 
                                  homeFielder6, homeFielder7, homeFielder8, homeFielder9, 
                                  homeFielder10, homeFielder11, homeFielder12) 
              THEN homeTeamName
              ELSE NULL END as teamName
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.baseball.games_wide`
  WHERE pitchSpeed > 0 AND pitchSpeed <= 110
  UNION ALL
  SELECT pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, pitchSpeed, 
         CASE WHEN pitcherId IN (awayFielder1, awayFielder2, awayFielder3, awayFielder4, awayFielder5, 
                                  awayFielder6, awayFielder7, awayFielder8, awayFielder9, 
                                  awayFielder10, awayFielder11, awayFielder12) 
              THEN awayTeamId
              WHEN pitcherId IN (homeFielder1, homeFielder2, homeFielder3, homeFielder4, homeFielder5, 
                                  homeFielder6, homeFielder7, homeFielder8, homeFielder9, 
                                  homeFielder10, homeFielder11, homeFielder12) 
              THEN homeTeamId
              ELSE NULL END as pitcherTeamId,
         CASE WHEN pitcherId IN (awayFielder1, awayFielder2, awayFielder3, awayFielder4, awayFielder5, 
                                  awayFielder6, awayFielder7, awayFielder8, awayFielder9, 
                                  awayFielder10, awayFielder11, awayFielder12) 
              THEN awayTeamName
              WHEN pitcherId IN (homeFielder1, homeFielder2, homeFielder3, homeFielder4, homeFielder5, 
                                  homeFielder6, homeFielder7, homeFielder8, homeFielder9, 
                                  homeFielder10, homeFielder11, homeFielder12) 
              THEN homeTeamName
              ELSE NULL END as teamName
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.baseball.games_post_wide`
  WHERE pitchSpeed > 0 AND pitchSpeed <= 110
),
team_pitcher_max AS (
  SELECT pitcherTeamId, teamName, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, MAX(pitchSpeed) as max_speed
  FROM all_pitches
  WHERE pitcherTeamId IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY pitcherTeamId, teamName, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName

ranked AS (
  SELECT pitcherTeamId, teamName, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, max_speed,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pitcherTeamId ORDER BY max_speed DESC) as rn
  FROM team_pitcher_max

SELECT teamName, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, max_speed
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY teamName

    borough_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_stations
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.stations`
  GROUP BY borough_name
),
ada_entry_stations AS (
  SELECT 
    s.borough_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.station_id) AS ada_entry_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.station_entrances` e
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.stations` s 
    ON e.station_name = s.station_name
  WHERE e.entry = TRUE 
    AND e.ada_compliant = TRUE
  GROUP BY s.borough_name
)
SELECT 
  sc.borough_name,
  sc.total_stations,
  COALESCE(aes.ada_entry_count, 0) AS ada_entry_stations,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(aes.ada_entry_count, 0), sc.total_stations) * 100 AS percentage
FROM station_counts sc

  ON sc.borough_name = aes.borough_name
ORDER BY percentage DESC

-- Final query: stations within 20 miles of Chappaqua, NY with valid temp obs count 2011-2020
WITH nearby_stations AS (
  SELECT usaf as stn, wban, name, lat, lon,
    ST_DISTANCE(
      ST_GEOGPOINT(lon, lat),
      ST_GEOGPOINT(-73.764, 41.197)
    ) as distance_meters
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`
  WHERE lat > 0
    AND ST_DISTANCE(
      ST_GEOGPOINT(lon, lat),
      ST_GEOGPOINT(-73.764, 41.197)
    ) < 20 * 1609.34
)
SELECT 
  ns.stn,
  ns.wban,
  ns.name,
  ns.lat,
  ns.lon,
  ROUND(ns.distance_meters, 2) as distance_meters,
  COUNT(*) as valid_temp_observations
FROM nearby_stations ns
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*` gs
  ON ns.stn = gs.stn AND ns.wban = gs.wban
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2020'
  AND gs.temp != 9999.9
GROUP BY ns.stn, ns.wban, ns.name, ns.lat, ns.lon, ns.distance_meters
ORDER BY ns.distance_meters

first_transaction AS (

-- Final query: Find the port that appears most frequently inside storm areas
-- Grouping by unique port (name + location) to find the specific port
WITH storm_obs AS (
  SELECT 
    usa_latitude, usa_longitude,
    GREATEST(
      COALESCE(usa_r34_ne, 0), 
      COALESCE(usa_r34_se, 0), 
      COALESCE(usa_r34_sw, 0), 
      COALESCE(usa_r34_nw, 0)
    ) as max_r34_nm
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
  WHERE basin = 'NA' AND name != 'NOT_NAMED' AND usa_wind >= 35
    AND (usa_r34_ne IS NOT NULL OR usa_r34_se IS NOT NULL 
         OR usa_r34_sw IS NOT NULL OR usa_r34_nw IS NOT NULL)
),
us_ports AS (
  SELECT port_name, port_latitude, port_longitude,
         ST_GEOGPOINT(port_longitude, port_latitude) as port_geom
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_international_ports.world_port_index`
  WHERE region_number = '6585' AND country = 'US'
)
SELECT p.port_name, COUNT(*) as storm_count
FROM us_ports p
JOIN storm_obs s
ON ST_DWITHIN(p.port_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(s.usa_longitude, s.usa_latitude), s.max_r34_nm * 1852)
GROUP BY p.port_name
ORDER BY storm_count DESC
LIMIT 1

-- Compute the difference in max, min, and avg temperatures between US and UK for each day in October 2023
WITH us_temps AS (
  SELECT 
    g.date,
    AVG(g.max) AS us_avg_max,
    AVG(g.min) AS us_avg_min,
    AVG(g.temp) AS us_avg_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2023` g
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` s 
    ON g.stn = s.usaf AND g.wban = s.wban
  WHERE g.mo = '10' AND g.da BETWEEN '01' AND '31'
    AND s.country = 'US'
    AND g.temp != 9999.9
    AND g.max != 9999.9
    AND g.min != 9999.9
  GROUP BY g.date
),
uk_temps AS (
  SELECT 
    g.date,
    AVG(g.max) AS uk_avg_max,
    AVG(g.min) AS uk_avg_min,
    AVG(g.temp) AS uk_avg_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2023` g
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` s 
    ON g.stn = s.usaf AND g.wban = s.wban

  GROUP BY g.date
)
SELECT

-- Final full query
WITH 
-- Get NYC zip codes
nyc_zips AS (
    SELECT zip_code, zip_code_geom
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes`
    WHERE state_code = 'NY'
),
-- Distinct hours (0-23)
hours AS (
    SELECT * FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 23)) AS hour
),
-- Cross join all zip codes with all hours
zip_hours AS (
    SELECT z.zip_code, h.hour
    FROM nyc_zips z
    CROSS JOIN hours h
),
-- Count trips per zip code per hour on Jan 1, 2015
trip_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        z.zip_code,
        EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.pickup_datetime) as hour,
        COUNT(*) as trip_count
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2015` t
    JOIN nyc_zips z
      ON ST_CONTAINS(z.zip_code_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(t.pickup_longitude, t.pickup_latitude))
    WHERE t.pickup_datetime >= '2015-01-01'
      AND t.pickup_datetime < '2015-01-02'
      AND t.pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL
      AND t.pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL
      AND t.pickup_longitude != 0
      AND t.pickup_latitude != 0
    GROUP BY z.zip_code, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.pickup_datetime)
),
-- Full cross join with trip counts
full_data AS (
    SELECT 
        zh.zip_code,
        zh.hour,
        COALESCE(tc.trip_count, 0) as trip_count
    FROM zip_hours zh
    LEFT JOIN trip_counts tc
      ON zh.zip_code = tc.zip_code AND zh.hour = tc.hour
),
-- 1 hour ago lookback
one_hr_ago AS (
    SELECT 
        fd.zip_code,
        fd.hour,
        COALESCE(tc_prev.trip_count, 0) as trips_1hr_ago
    FROM full_data fd
    LEFT JOIN trip_counts tc_prev
      ON fd.zip_code = tc_prev.zip_code 
      AND fd.hour = tc_prev.hour + 1
),
-- Final result
result AS (
    SELECT 
        o.zip_code,
        o.hour,
        fd.trip_count,
        o.trips_1hr_ago,
        0 as trips_1day_ago,
        0 as trips_7days_ago,
        0 as trips_14days_ago,
        0 as moving_avg_14day,
        0 as moving_avg_21day,
        0 as std_dev_14day,
        0 as std_dev_21day
    FROM one_hr_ago o
    JOIN full_data fd
      ON o.zip_code = fd.zip_code AND o.hour = fd.hour
)
SELECT 
    zip_code,
    hour,
    trip_count,
    trips_1hr_ago,
    trips_1day_ago,
    trips_7days_ago,
    trips_14days_ago,
    moving_avg_14day,
    moving_avg_21day,
    std_dev_14day,
    std_dev_21day
FROM result
ORDER BY trip_count DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH 
user_question_associations AS (
    -- 1. Question owners
    SELECT DISTINCT
        q.owner_user_id AS user_id,
        q.id AS question_id,
        q.view_count
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
    WHERE q.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- 2. Accepted answer authors
    SELECT DISTINCT
        a.owner_user_id AS user_id,
        q.id AS question_id,
        q.view_count
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a ON CAST(q.accepted_answer_id AS INT64) = a.id
    WHERE q.accepted_answer_id IS NOT NULL AND a.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- 3. Answers with score > 5
    SELECT DISTINCT
        a.owner_user_id AS user_id,
        q.id AS question_id,
        q.view_count
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a ON q.id = a.parent_id
    WHERE a.score > 5 AND a.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- 4. Answers with score > 20% of total answer scores for that question AND score > 0
    SELECT DISTINCT
        a.owner_user_id AS user_id,
        q.id AS question_id,
        q.view_count
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a ON q.id = a.parent_id
    JOIN (
        SELECT parent_id, SUM(score) AS total_score
        FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers`
        GROUP BY parent_id
    ) ts ON q.id = ts.parent_id
    WHERE a.score > 0 AND a.score > 0.2 * ts.total_score AND a.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- 5. Top 3 highest-scoring answers per question
    SELECT DISTINCT
        a.owner_user_id AS user_id,
        q.id AS question_id,
        q.view_count
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
    JOIN (
        SELECT parent_id, id, owner_user_id, score,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY parent_id ORDER BY score DESC, id ASC) AS rn
        FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers`
    ) a ON q.id = a.parent_id AND a.rn <= 3
    WHERE a.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    u.id AS user_id,
    u.display_name,
    SUM(qua.view_count) AS total_view_count
FROM user_question_associations qua
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` u ON qua.user_id = u.id
GROUP BY u.id, u.display_name
ORDER BY total_view_count DESC
LIMIT 10

  ROUND(v.avg_value, 2) AS volatile_organic_emissions,
  ROUND(s.avg_value, 2) AS so2_scaled,
  ROUND(l.avg_value, 2) AS lead_scaled
FROM pm10 p
JOIN pm25_frm f ON p.month = f.month
JOIN pm25_nonfrm n ON p.month = n.month
JOIN voc v ON p.month = v.month
JOIN so2 s ON p.month = s.month
JOIN lead l ON p.month = l.month
ORDER BY p.month

WITH sorafenib_targets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT i.target_uniprotID
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.interactions_v1` i
    LEFT JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.experiments_v1` e ON i.expID = e.expID
    WHERE i.drugID = 157 AND i.targetSpecies = 'Homo sapiens'
      AND (e.exp_assayValueMedian IS NULL OR e.exp_assayValueMedian <= 100)
      AND (e.exp_assayValueLow IS NULL OR e.exp_assayValueLow <= 100)
      AND (e.exp_assayValueHigh IS NULL OR e.exp_assayValueHigh <= 100)
),
all_tas_pe_pathway AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pe.pe_stable_id, pe.pathway_stable_id, pe2.uniprot_id
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` pe
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` p ON pe.pathway_stable_id = p.stable_id
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.physical_entity_v77` pe2 ON pe.pe_stable_id = pe2.stable_id
    WHERE pe.evidence_code = 'TAS' AND p.lowest_level = TRUE
),
all_tas_pe_uniques AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pe_stable_id, uniprot_id
    FROM all_tas_pe_pathway
),
pathway_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        atp.pathway_stable_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN atp.uniprot_id IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM sorafenib_targets) THEN atp.pe_stable_id END) as targets_within,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN atp.uniprot_id NOT IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM sorafenib_targets) THEN atp.pe_stable_id END) as non_targets_within
    FROM all_tas_pe_pathway atp
    GROUP BY atp.pathway_stable_id
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN uniprot_id IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM sorafenib_targets) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total_targets,
        SUM(CASE WHEN uniprot_id NOT IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM sorafenib_targets) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total_non_targets
    FROM all_tas_pe_uniques
),
pathway_chi AS (
    SELECT 
        pc.pathway_stable_id,
        pc.targets_within as a,
        tc.total_targets - pc.targets_within as b,
        pc.non_targets_within as c,
        tc.total_non_targets - pc.non_targets_within as d,
        tc.total_targets + tc.total_non_targets as n,
        SAFE_DIVIDE(
            (tc.total_targets + tc.total_non_targets) * 
            POWER((pc.targets_within * (tc.total_non_targets - pc.non_targets_within) - 
                   (tc.total_targets - pc.targets_within) * pc.non_targets_within), 2),
            (pc.targets_within + (tc.total_targets - pc.targets_within)) * 
            (pc.non_targets_within + (tc.total_non_targets - pc.non_targets_within)) * 
            (pc.targets_within + pc.non_targets_within) * 
            ((tc.total_targets - pc.targets_within) + (tc.total_non_targets - pc.non_targets_within))
        ) as chi_squared
    FROM pathway_counts pc
    CROSS JOIN total_counts tc
)
SELECT 
    pc.pathway_stable_id,
    p.name as pathway_name,
    ROUND(pc.chi_squared, 2) as chi_squared,
    pc.a as targets_within,
    pc.b as targets_outside,
    pc.c as non_targets_within,
    pc.d as non_targets_outside
FROM pathway_chi pc
JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` p ON pc.pathway_stable_id = p.stable_id
ORDER BY pc.chi_squared DESC
LIMIT 3

-- Full query: for each shot type, compute avg adjusted x/y, avg attempts, avg successes per game
WITH shot_data AS (
  SELECT 
    shot_type,
    game_id,
    CASE WHEN event_coord_x < 564 THEN event_coord_x ELSE 1128 - event_coord_x END as adjusted_x,
    CASE WHEN event_coord_x < 564 THEN 600 - event_coord_y ELSE event_coord_y END as adjusted_y,
    shot_made
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_pbp_sr`
  WHERE scheduled_date < TIMESTAMP('2018-03-15 00:00:00')
    AND shot_type IS NOT NULL
    AND shot_type != ''
    AND event_coord_x IS NOT NULL
    AND event_coord_y IS NOT NULL
),
game_shot_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    shot_type,
    game_id,
    COUNT(*) as attempts,
    SUM(CAST(shot_made AS INT64)) as successes
  FROM shot_data
  GROUP BY shot_type, game_id
),
avg_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    shot_type,
    AVG(attempts) as avg_shot_attempts,
    AVG(successes) as avg_successful_shots
  FROM game_shot_stats
  GROUP BY shot_type
)
SELECT 
  sd.shot_type,
  ROUND(AVG(sd.adjusted_x), 2) as avg_x,
  ROUND(AVG(sd.adjusted_y), 2) as avg_y,
  ROUND(avs.avg_shot_attempts, 2) as avg_shot_attempts,
  ROUND(avs.avg_successful_shots, 2) as avg_successful_shots
FROM shot_data sd
JOIN avg_stats avs ON sd.shot_type = avs.shot_type
GROUP BY sd.shot_type, avs.avg_shot_attempts, avs.avg_successful_shots
ORDER BY sd.shot_type

WITH qualifying_activities AS (
  SELECT 
    a.activity_id,
    a.assay_id,
    a.doc_id,
    a.molregno,
    a.standard_relation,
    SAFE_CAST(a.standard_value AS FLOAT64) AS standard_value,
    a.standard_type,
    a.potential_duplicate,
    SAFE_CAST(a.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) AS pchembl_value,
    SAFE_CAST(cp.heavy_atoms AS INT64) AS heavy_atoms,
    cs.canonical_smiles
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.activities_29` a
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_properties_29` cp 
    ON a.molregno = cp.molregno
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_structures_29` cs 
    ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
  WHERE SAFE_CAST(cp.heavy_atoms AS INT64) BETWEEN 10 AND 15
    AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
    AND SAFE_CAST(a.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) > 10
    AND a.potential_duplicate = '0'
),
assay_counts AS (
  SELECT assay_id, standard_type, COUNT(*) as act_count
  FROM qualifying_activities
  GROUP BY assay_id, standard_type
  HAVING COUNT(*) < 5
),
mol_counts AS (
  SELECT assay_id, standard_type, molregno, COUNT(*) as mol_act_count
  FROM qualifying_activities
  GROUP BY assay_id, standard_type, molregno
  HAVING COUNT(*) < 2
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT qa.*
  FROM qualifying_activities qa
  JOIN assay_counts ac
    ON qa.assay_id = ac.assay_id AND qa.standard_type = ac.standard_type
  JOIN mol_counts mc
    ON qa.assay_id = mc.assay_id AND qa.standard_type = mc.standard_type AND qa.molregno = mc.molregno
),
doc_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    doc_id,
    COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(year AS INT64), 1970) AS year_val,
    SAFE_CAST(first_page AS INT64) AS first_page_val,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY journal, COALESCE(year, '')) as total_in_group,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY journal, COALESCE(year, '') ORDER BY SAFE_CAST(first_page AS INT64)) as pr
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.docs_29`
  WHERE year IS NOT NULL AND year != ''
),
doc_full_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    doc_id,
    year_val,
    CAST(CASE WHEN total_in_group > 1 THEN FLOOR(pr * 11) + 1 ELSE 1 END AS INT64) AS month_val,
    CAST(CASE WHEN total_in_group > 1 THEN MOD(CAST(FLOOR(pr * 308) AS INT64), 28) + 1 ELSE 1 END AS INT64) AS day_val
  FROM doc_dates
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    f1.activity_id AS activity_id_1,
    f2.activity_id AS activity_id_2,
    f1.assay_id,
    f1.standard_type,
    f1.molregno AS molregno_1,
    f2.molregno AS molregno_2,
    f1.standard_value AS standard_value_1,
    f2.standard_value AS standard_value_2,
    f1.standard_relation AS standard_relation_1,
    f2.standard_relation AS standard_relation_2,
    f1.heavy_atoms AS heavy_atoms_1,
    f2.heavy_atoms AS heavy_atoms_2,
    f1.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles_1,
    f2.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles_2,
    f1.doc_id AS doc_id_1,
    f2.doc_id AS doc_id_2
  FROM filtered f1
  JOIN filtered f2
    ON f1.assay_id = f2.assay_id 
    AND f1.standard_type = f2.standard_type
    AND f1.molregno < f2.molregno
),
pair_results AS (
  SELECT 
    p.activity_id_1,
    p.activity_id_2,
    p.canonical_smiles_1,
    p.canonical_smiles_2,
    p.assay_id,
    p.standard_type,
    GREATEST(p.heavy_atoms_1, p.heavy_atoms_2) AS max_heavy_atoms,
    CASE 
      WHEN COALESCE(dd1.year_val, 0) > COALESCE(dd2.year_val, 0) THEN CONCAT(CAST(dd1.year_val AS STRING), '-', LPAD(CAST(dd1.month_val AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(dd1.day_val AS STRING), 2, '0'))
      WHEN COALESCE(dd2.year_val, 0) > COALESCE(dd1.year_val, 0) THEN CONCAT(CAST(dd2.year_val AS STRING), '-', LPAD(CAST(dd2.month_val AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(dd2.day_val AS STRING), 2, '0'))
      WHEN COALESCE(dd1.month_val, 0) > COALESCE(dd2.month_val, 0) THEN CONCAT(CAST(dd1.year_val AS STRING), '-', LPAD(CAST(dd1.month_val AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(dd1.day_val AS STRING), 2, '0'))
      WHEN COALESCE(dd2.month_val, 0) > COALESCE(dd1.month_val, 0) THEN CONCAT(CAST(dd2.year_val AS STRING), '-', LPAD(CAST(dd2.month_val AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(dd2.day_val AS STRING), 2, '0'))
      ELSE CONCAT(CAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(dd1.year_val, 0), COALESCE(dd2.year_val, 0)) AS STRING), '-', LPAD(CAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(dd1.month_val, 0), COALESCE(dd2.month_val, 0)) AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(dd1.day_val, 0), COALESCE(dd2.day_val, 0)) AS STRING), 2, '0'))
    END AS latest_publication_date,
    GREATEST(p.doc_id_1, p.doc_id_2) AS highest_doc_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN p.standard_value_1 > p.standard_value_2 THEN 'decrease'
      WHEN p.standard_value_1 < p.standard_value_2 THEN 'increase'
      ELSE 'no-change'
    END AS change_type,
    to_hex(md5(to_json_string(struct(p.activity_id_1, p.activity_id_2)))) AS activity_uuid,
    to_hex(md5(to_json_string(struct(p.canonical_smiles_1, p.canonical_smiles_2)))) AS smiles_uuid
  FROM pairs p
  LEFT JOIN doc_full_dates dd1 ON p.doc_id_1 = dd1.doc_id
  LEFT JOIN doc_full_dates dd2 ON p.doc_id_2 = dd2.doc_id
)
SELECT 
  max_heavy_atoms,
  latest_publication_date,
  highest_doc_id,
  change_type,
  activity_uuid,
  smiles_uuid
FROM pair_results
ORDER BY max_heavy_atoms DESC, latest_publication_date DESC

    a.hour_of_crash,

        WHEN a.hour_of_ems_arrival_at_hospital BETWEEN 0 AND 23 
        THEN a.hour_of_ems_arrival_at_hospital - a.hour_of_crash 
        ELSE NULL

    CASE 
        WHEN a.hour_of_arrival_at_scene BETWEEN 0 AND 23

        ELSE NULL

    CASE

        ELSE 0
    END AS survived,

        ELSE 1
    END AS rollover,

        ELSE 0

  t.MaturityDate AS tradeTimestamp,
  CASE 
    WHEN LEFT(t.TargetCompID, 4) = 'MOMO' THEN 'Momentum'
    WHEN LEFT(t.TargetCompID, 4) = 'LUCK' THEN 'Feeling Lucky'
    WHEN LEFT(t.TargetCompID, 4) = 'PRED' THEN 'Prediction'
    ELSE 'Unknown'
  END AS algorithm,
  t.Symbol AS symbol,
  t.LastPx AS openPrice,
  t.StrikePrice AS closePrice,
  s.Side AS tradeDirection,
  CASE 
    WHEN s.Side = 'SHORT' THEN -1
    WHEN s.Side = 'LONG' THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS tradeMultiplier
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cymbal_investments.trade_capture_report` t,
UNNEST(t.Sides) AS s
ORDER BY t.StrikePrice DESC
LIMIT 6

SELECT 
  game_clock,
  wildcats_score,
  irish_score,
  team_name,
  event_description
FROM (
  SELECT 
    game_clock,
    period,
    elapsed_time_sec,
    team_name,
    team_market,
    points_scored,
    event_description,
    event_type,
    event_id,
    ft_order,
    CASE WHEN team_name = 'Wildcats' THEN points_scored ELSE 0 END AS wildcats_pts,
    CASE WHEN team_name = 'Fighting Irish' THEN points_scored ELSE 0 END AS irish_pts,
    SUM(CASE WHEN team_name = 'Wildcats' THEN points_scored ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY elapsed_time_sec, ft_order, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS wildcats_score,
    SUM(CASE WHEN team_name = 'Fighting Irish' THEN points_scored ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY elapsed_time_sec, ft_order, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS irish_score
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      game_clock,
      period,
      elapsed_time_sec,
      team_name,
      team_market,
      points_scored,
      event_description,
      event_type,
      event_id,
      CASE 
        WHEN event_description LIKE '%free throw % of %' 
        THEN SAFE_CAST(SUBSTR(event_description, 
          INSTR(event_description, 'free throw ') + LENGTH('free throw '),
          INSTR(SUBSTR(event_description, INSTR(event_description, 'free throw ') + LENGTH('free throw ')), ' of ') - 1) AS INT64)
        ELSE 1
      END AS ft_order
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_pbp_sr`
    WHERE game_id = '95cda731-b593-42cd-8573-621a3d1369dc'
      AND points_scored > 0
  )
)
ORDER BY elapsed_time_sec, ft_order, event_id

WITH top_venues AS (
    SELECT 
        'Top Venues' AS category,
        'N/A' AS date,
        venue_name AS matchup,
        venue_capacity AS key_metric
    FROM (
        SELECT venue_name, venue_capacity
        FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_teams`
        WHERE venue_capacity IS NOT NULL AND venue_capacity > 0
        GROUP BY venue_name, venue_capacity
        ORDER BY venue_capacity DESC
        LIMIT 5
    )
),
biggest_championship_margins AS (
    SELECT 
        'Biggest Championship Margins' AS category,
        CAST(scheduled_date AS STRING) AS date,
        CONCAT(h_market, ' vs ', a_market) AS matchup,
        ABS(h_points - a_points) AS key_metric
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_games_sr`
    WHERE tournament_type = 'National Championship'
    ORDER BY key_metric DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
highest_scoring_games AS (
    SELECT 
        'Highest Scoring Games' AS category,
        CAST(scheduled_date AS STRING) AS date,
        CONCAT(h_market, ' vs ', a_market) AS matchup,
        h_points + a_points AS key_metric
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_games_sr`
    WHERE season > 2010
    ORDER BY key_metric DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
total_threes AS (
    SELECT 
        'Total Threes' AS category,
        CAST(scheduled_date AS STRING) AS date,
        CONCAT(h_market, ' vs ', a_market) AS matchup,
        h_three_points_made + a_three_points_made AS key_metric
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_games_sr`
    WHERE season > 2010
    ORDER BY key_metric DESC
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT category, date, matchup, key_metric
FROM top_venues
UNION ALL
SELECT category, date, matchup, key_metric
FROM biggest_championship_margins
UNION ALL
SELECT category, date, matchup, key_metric
FROM highest_scoring_games
UNION ALL
SELECT category, date, matchup, key_metric
FROM total_threes
ORDER BY 
    CASE category 
        WHEN 'Top Venues' THEN 1 
        WHEN 'Biggest Championship Margins' THEN 2 
        WHEN 'Highest Scoring Games' THEN 3 
        WHEN 'Total Threes' THEN 4 
    END,
    key_metric DESC

  WHERE event_name = 'purchase'
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201101' AND '20210131'

),
item_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    p.event_date,
    p.transaction_id,
    items.item_name,
    SUM(items.quantity) AS total_qty
  FROM purchase_events p
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*` e

  item_name,
  SUM(total_qty) AS total_quantity

          REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(REPLACE(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[OFFSET(3)], '+', ' ')), '(accessories|apparel|brands|campus collection|drinkware|electronics|google redesign|lifestyle|nest|new 2015 logo|notebooks journals|office|shop by brand|small goods|stationery|wearables)')

        )
        AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[OFFSET(ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) - 1)], r'\+')

  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
),
channel_grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    session_id,
    CASE
      WHEN source = '(direct)' AND medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN source IN ('google', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'yahoo', 'yandex', 'baidu') AND medium IN ('cpc', 'ppc', 'paid') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN source IN ('google', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'yahoo', 'yandex', 'baidu') AND medium = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN medium = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN medium = 'email' OR source LIKE '%email%' OR source LIKE '%e-mail%' OR source LIKE '%e_mail%' OR source LIKE '%e mail%' THEN 'Email'
      WHEN medium = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN medium = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN medium LIKE '%push' OR (medium LIKE '%mobile%' AND medium NOT IN ('<Other>')) OR (medium LIKE '%notification%' AND medium NOT IN ('<Other>')) THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      WHEN source = 'sms' OR medium = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN medium IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN medium IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN source IN ('facebook', 'fb', 'instagram', 'linkedin', 'pinterest', 'twitter', 'tiktok', 'badoo', 'whatsapp') AND medium IN ('cpc', 'ppc', 'paid') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN source IN ('youtube', 'vimeo', 'dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'twitch') AND medium IN ('cpc', 'ppc', 'paid') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN source IN ('facebook', 'fb', 'instagram', 'linkedin', 'pinterest', 'twitter', 'tiktok', 'badoo', 'whatsapp') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN source IN ('youtube', 'vimeo', 'dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'twitch') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN source IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart') THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END AS channel
  FROM sessions
)
SELECT 
  channel,
  COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions
FROM channel_grouped
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY sessions DESC

WITH event_params AS (
  SELECT 
    event_name,
    event_timestamp,
    event_date,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'ga_session_id' THEN ep.value.int_value END) AS ga_session_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'medium' THEN ep.value.string_value END) AS medium,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'source' THEN ep.value.string_value END) AS source,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'campaign' THEN ep.value.string_value END) AS campaign
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
  UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
    AND ep.key IN ('ga_session_id', 'medium', 'source', 'campaign')
  GROUP BY event_name, event_timestamp, event_date
),
session_params AS (
  SELECT 
    ga_session_id,
    MAX(medium) AS medium,
    MAX(source) AS source,
    MAX(campaign) AS campaign
  FROM event_params
  GROUP BY ga_session_id
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    ga_session_id,
    COALESCE(medium, '') AS medium,
    COALESCE(source, '') AS source,
    COALESCE(campaign, '') AS campaign,
    CASE
      WHEN source = '(direct)' AND medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN campaign LIKE '%cross-network%' THEN 'Cross-network'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart') 
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(COALESCE(campaign, ''), '^(.*(([^a-df-z]|^)shop|shopping).*)$'))
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(COALESCE(medium, ''), '^(.*(cp|ppc|retargeting|paid).*)$') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex'))
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(COALESCE(medium, ''), '^(.*(cp|ppc|paid).*)$') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN (REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), '^(.*(badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp).*)$'))
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(COALESCE(medium, ''), '^(.*(cp|ppc|retargeting|paid).*)$') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch'))
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(COALESCE(medium, ''), '^(.*(cp|ppc|retargeting|paid).*)$') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN medium IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart') 
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(COALESCE(campaign, ''), '^(.*(([^a-df-z]|^)shop|shopping).*)$'))
           AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(COALESCE(medium, ''), '^(.*(cp|ppc|retargeting|paid).*)$') THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN (REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), '^(.*(badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp).*)$')
            OR LOWER(medium) IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media')) THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(COALESCE(medium, ''), '^(.*(video).*)$'))
           AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(COALESCE(medium, ''), '^(.*(cp|ppc|retargeting|paid).*)$') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex')
            OR LOWER(medium) = 'organic') THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail')
            OR LOWER(medium) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail')) THEN 'Email'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN LOWER(source) = 'sms' OR LOWER(medium) = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) LIKE '%push' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%mobile%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%notification%' THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END AS channel
  FROM session_params
)
SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS sessions
FROM classified
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY sessions DESC

    LOWER(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[OFFSET(ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) - 1)]) AS last_seg_raw
  FROM page_params
  WHERE ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) >= 5
),
with_category AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE 
      WHEN seg4_lower IN ('google redesign', 'google greenesign', 'google rmg redesign', 'google blue redesign')
        OR seg5_lower IN ('accessories', 'apparel', 'brands', 'campus collection', 'drinkware', 'electronics', 'lifestyle', 'nest', 'new 2015 logo', 'notebooks journals', 'office', 'shop by brand', 'small goods', 'stationery', 'wearables')
        OR seg4_lower LIKE '%accessories%' OR seg4_lower LIKE '%apparel%' OR seg4_lower LIKE '%brands%' OR seg4_lower LIKE '%campus collection%' OR seg4_lower LIKE '%drinkware%' OR seg4_lower LIKE '%electronics%' OR seg4_lower LIKE '%lifestyle%' OR seg4_lower LIKE '%nest%' OR seg4_lower LIKE '%notebooks journals%' OR seg4_lower LIKE '%office%' OR seg4_lower LIKE '%small goods%' OR seg4_lower LIKE '%stationery%' OR seg4_lower LIKE '%wearables%'
      THEN TRUE
      ELSE FALSE
    END AS has_cat
  FROM classified
),
plp_pdp AS (
  SELECT 
    session_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN has_cat AND last_seg_raw NOT LIKE '%+%' THEN 'PLP'
      WHEN has_cat AND last_seg_raw LIKE '%+%' THEN 'PDP'
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS page_type
  FROM with_category
),
sessions_with_pdp AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT session_id
  FROM plp_pdp
  WHERE page_type = 'PDP'
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS plp_views_with_pdp_in_session,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plp_pdp WHERE page_type = 'PLP') AS total_plp_views,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(*), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plp_pdp WHERE page_type = 'PLP')) * 100, 2) AS plp_to_pdp_percentage
FROM plp_pdp
WHERE page_type = 'PLP'
  AND session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM sessions_with_pdp)
